en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from one of his companions, from Aban, from a man, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘There was in the house of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, a pair of red pigeons’.
en.sarwar: 16. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from certain persons of his people from Aban from a man who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that in the house of the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause,
there was a pair of red pigeons.’”
